requirement: The system shall refuse a reservation when the requested vehicle class has no available car for any day in the rental period.
The system shall compute the total rental price as the daily rate for the chosen class multiplied by the number of days, plus any selected extras and applicable taxes.
The customer selects a vehicle and dates; the system validates the driver licence, confirms availability and records the reservation with a pending payment.
The agent checks out a reserved vehicle; the system records the starting mileage and fuel level and marks the vehicle as on rent.
As a customer, I want to view my upcoming and past rentals so that I can plan and keep records.
As a fleet manager, I want to mark a vehicle as off-road so that it cannot be assigned to any new reservation while it is unavailable.
A driver with fewer than two years of licence history must not be allowed to rent a high-performance vehicle class.
Every reservation status change must be recorded with the previous status, the new status, the operator and a timestamp.
The reservation table shall ensure that pickup is before drop-off, that the status is a recognised value and that the total price is never negative.

-- rental reservation table
CREATE TABLE rental_reservation (
    reservation_id   BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id      VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    vehicle_class    VARCHAR(30)   NOT NULL,
    location_id      VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    pickup_date      DATE          NOT NULL,
    dropoff_date     DATE          NOT NULL,
    total_price      NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
    status           VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    created_at       TIMESTAMP     NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT reservation_dates_order CHECK (dropoff_date > pickup_date),
    CONSTRAINT reservation_price_nonneg CHECK (total_price >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT reservation_status_chk CHECK (status IN ('PENDING','CONFIRMED','CHECKED_OUT','RETURNED','CANCELLED','NO_SHOW'))
);

CREATE INDEX reservation_customer_idx ON rental_reservation (customer_id, pickup_date);

-- vehicle master table
CREATE TABLE vehicle (
    vehicle_id      BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    registration    VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    vehicle_class   VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL,
    home_location   VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    status          VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    current_mileage INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT vehicle_reg_unique UNIQUE (registration),
    CONSTRAINT vehicle_status_chk CHECK (status IN ('AVAILABLE','ON_RENT','MAINTENANCE','OFF_ROAD','RETIRED'))
);
-- daily fleet availability snapshot table
CREATE TABLE daily_availability (
    location_id    VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    vehicle_class  VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    stay_date      DATE        NOT NULL,
    total_cars     INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    reserved_cars  INTEGER     NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CONSTRAINT availability_pk PRIMARY KEY (location_id, vehicle_class, stay_date),
    CONSTRAINT availability_reserved_range CHECK (reserved_cars BETWEEN 0 AND total_cars)
);

requirement: Only the customer who made a reservation may cancel it; staff may cancel on their behalf only with an operator role.
The nightly reconciliation job shall produce a report of every vehicle that is due back today but not yet returned, together with the customer and reservation contact details.
